description_en: Queries the connections established over the ports of one or more Anti-DDoS Proxy instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的端口连接数列表
name: DescribePortConnsList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The interval for returning data. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 返回数据的步长，单位为秒，即每隔多少秒返回一个结果
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The number of port that you want to query. If you do not specify this parameter, all ports are queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的端口号。不传入该参数表示查询所有端口
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_ids

ConnsList.description_en: Details about the connections established over the port

Conns.description_en: This parameter is in internal preview. Do not use this parameter
Conns.description_zh: 该参数在内部测试中，暂时请勿使用

Index.description_en: The index number of the returned data

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
